training.method: greedy bit selection with internal training-only holdout; supervised integer LUT coordinate descent
training.lut_scope: per descriptor dimension, shared across all images and keypoints
training.teacher: training-scene per-dimension quantile bins; regularization only
training.unseen_pattern_policy: training dimension mean bin; never fitted on evaluation data

manifest.note: image-disjoint synthetic homographies; COCO val2017 is our training source, not a COCO official benchmark

accuracy_equivalence: ABS and thermometer must match exactly, including deterministic tie-breaking
timing_scope: CPU encode/pack/matching; XFeat extraction excluded and reported separately; no claimed SIMD4 optimization
